final: WITH pt AS (SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(l.APTT) AS avg_aptt, AVG(l.ALB - l.TP) AS avg_diff FROM Laboratory l JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX), sx AS (SELECT SEX, AVG(avg_aptt) AS avg_aptt, AVG(avg_diff) AS A FROM pt GROUP BY SEX), b AS (SELECT AVG(A) AS B FROM sx) SELECT sx.SEX, sx.avg_aptt, sx.A, sx.A - b.B AS A_minus_B FROM sx JOIN b ON b.B IS NOT NULL WHERE sx.A > b.B
